Added WATCHING section for regime changes, ADX thresholds, funding extremes, volume spikes, OI moves
Major performance fix: parallelized OKX requests, 1.2s runtime (was 5-6 min)
Fixed: Added jq to required binaries for symbol lookup example
Fixed: Declared required binaries (python3, curl, uvx) in metadata
Fixed: volume display format, improved caching for funding/OI changes
Enhanced reports: added distance from Supertrend, volume vs 20d avg, funding rate change, open interest, BTC correlation
Initial release - daily and weekly regime reports with Supertrend/ADX, configurable watchlist, OKX + Yahoo Finance data sources
